column2: The Dragon King does not leave the Great House of St. George, and instead sends his emissaries to enforce his rule among the Congregation of Houses. His emissaries are masked in violet, and are sent to oversee the transition between Dragons, resolve territorial disputes between Houses, and to revoke House charters. The requirements to become a Violet Mask are shrouded in secrecy, and it is said that they know the answers to some of the most fundamental truths that underlie our organization's great work. In any case, it is known that they are all extremely dangerous.
